# vendor/kit4/

`evidence_kit/` here is a pinned copy of **evidence-kit 4.1.0** (from `claude/ai/evidence-kit`), the same version that renders
F1's Lab Console. It is copied, not linked. Only `tools/build_lab_console.py` uses it (in its own process); the article
builder keeps using `vendor/evidence_kit` (3.6.0).
